seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Ring A1/A2 moves y+-6 carrying blocks on beam rows; vertical move cancels if a pushed chain leaves the colour-4 field.
Beam A4/A3 w+-6; hook = any block on beam rows at x==tip-4 (tag-agnostic), then fully-on-beam blocks follow the tip; unhooked extend pushes the swept strip.
Blocked horizontal chain -> beam changes alone. Clicks/A5 are no-ops.
Tags: hooked next alone on beam -> collected (legend centre 0); collected off beam reverts; next by legend order.
HUD bar 3s=(n-1)//3, n=non-click actions, memo keyed by returned frames (fallback 3*bars+1); stateless run would fail on bar phase only.
